5 تصوّع It became dispersed, or scattered; as also ↓ انصاع . (S.) You say, تصوّع القَوْمُ The people, or party, became dispersed, or scattered, and remote, all of them, one from another. (O, K.) ―
-b2- Also, said of hair, It became contracted, and much split: [app. by reason of dryness: like تصوّح:] (Lth, O, K:) or it became dispersed, or scattered; (Lh, O, K;) and it fell off by degrees. (O, K.) ―
-b3- And, said of herbage, It became dried up; (S, O, K;) like تصوّح; (O;) as also تصيّع. (S; and O and K in art. صيع.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
